messages:
leila: Heads up — after pushing the pip constraints bump for cryptography to address CVE-2025-9999, CI is failing on the macos wheel build and several KMS integration tests are throwing signature errors.
maya: ugh, saw the mac wheel failure too. full log?
leila: pastebin: https://paste.redwood/abc123 - error snippet: 
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for cryptography which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
RuntimeError: HSM sign failed: invalid padding
```
ops-bot: @here CI job 8123 failed on branch main (eng-runtime).
ops-bot: tagging incident-severity:low because tests failing but fallback path exists.
todd: quick question — did we roll any changes to the KMS client or keystore lib in this constraints update?
leila: no code change, just `pip-constraints.txt` regen from resolve after pinning `cryptography==40.1.0` -> `40.2.1` and `cffi` bumped.
jason: those wheel build errors usually mean we need a matching binary wheel. macos build matrix uses manylinux wheels for Rust extensions; maybe cryptography upgraded to a new wheel platform.
sarah: could be the C extension ABI changed. Also KMS HSM sign error might be because the new cryptography linkages changed default padding/alg.
maya: repro steps I ran locally: `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -c pip-constraints.txt` -> cryptography builds from source on macos-latest, then tests fail in `tests/integration/test_kms.py::test_sign_verify`.
leila: timeline: bumped constraints to pick up CVE fix for cryptography; intended to close triage #358. CI red after merge ~5m ago.
todd: proposed options: 1) revert constraint bump and unblock CI, 2) pin to previous working wheel (temporary), 3) invest to make HSM client work with new cryptography (longer).
jason: we should prioritize: security vs availability. Is the CVE exploitable for our threat model?
sarah: CVE-2025-9999 is medium for us — requires local code execution to reach signing path; not public-facing. I recommend option 2 (pin) while we test compatibility.
maya: +1 pinback. We can schedule a deeper compatibility test and if needed, a small runtime change to KMS client to adjust padding.
ops-bot: @leila created rollback branch `rollback/cryptography-pin-40.1.0` and triggered CI.
leila: thanks — can someone validate the pin fixes the macos wheel step?
infra-bot: CI job 8130 (rollback branch) succeeded on macos wheel build.
leila: good. question for security: do we accept leaving CVE unpatched on main for ~48-72h?
sarah: acceptable with monitored exception and mitigation: restrict build-hosts and ensure no public ingress to signing endpoints. I'll file a temporary exception ticket.
todd: action items: 1) merge rollback pin to main (leila) 2) create a test matrix for cryptography upgrade (jason) 3) run KMS integration against upgrade in an isolated env (maya) 4) update ticket CVE-2025-9999 with timeline (sarah).
leila: merging rollback now.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for main -> staging.
maya: while we're here, can we add an audit log entry to the KMS client on signing errors? would help triage if this recurs. small PR suggested: `audit.log_error("kms.sign", error=str(e), key_id=key.id)`
jason: agree — also add a compatibility test that runs sign/verify against both cryptography versions in CI (matrix entry).
sarah: I will mark this CVE as "deferred-pinned" and note risk & mitigation. follow-up meeting in 2d to decide upgrade window.
leila: thanks team. postmortem-ish note: next time maybe run the wheel build matrix locally before constraint regen.
ops-bot: incident closed (low).
